comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
Before the open, make it write down the bid and ask it saw at the moment it decided, next to the price it actually got filled at. Two extra columns, five minutes of work.

You already expect it to miss the backtest. Those columns are what tell you which kind of miss it was. If the decision quote matches the backtest and the fill does not, your signal is fine and your fill assumption was fantasy. If the decision quote itself is off, the bot is seeing a different market than the one you tested on. Without that, week one just looks like bad luck.
